intro: Someone is waiting in the road ahead — and they carry themselves like a champion.$It's {{leaderName}}, far from their Gym!
speaker: {{leaderName}}
introDialogue: Well now! A trainer with fire in their eyes.$I'm traveling to sharpen my skills — and I never pass up a worthy opponent.$Beat me at full strength, and I'll entrust you with a partner I've raised myself.
title: Gym Leader Challenge
description: {{leaderName}} is offering an exhibition match against their true team — no badges, no rules, just strength. The prize: their personally trained {{giftSpecies}}, unlike any other of its kind.

1.label: Accept the Challenge
1.selected: {{leaderName}}'s expression sharpens into that of a Gym Leader.$"Then show me everything you have!"

2.label: Decline Politely
2.selected: {{leaderName}} laughs warmly.$"Another time, then. The road is long!"

giftGranted: {{giftName}} joined your party!$It carries the pride of its trainer — and power no ordinary Pokémon could know.
outro:
{{leaderName}} waves as they head down the road.
"Take good care of my partner — and never stop climbing!"
